newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo buys Hong Kong car paints distributor.
newsitem.headline: Akzo buys Hong Kong car paints distributor.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Monday it had bought car refinishing paints firm Sun Ling Apac Trading Ltd in Hong Kong.

"Akzo Nobel expects the acquisition to further strengthen its position in the Chinese market, which is currently showing growth of more than one million vehicles per year," the company said in a statement. No financial details were disclosed.
Sun Ling, which will be renamed Akzo Nobel Car Refinishes Hong Kong Ltd, distributes Akzo's Sikkens paints through more than 200 retailers in Hong Kong and China.
The Hong Kong-based company has four regional offices in China and a training center in Beijing. Akzo did not give turnover or profit figures for Sun Ling, but said the company employed 60 people.
